name: pulse-surveys
description: Multi-tenant weekly pulse surveys: NestJS + PostgreSQL backend with a small React front end.

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run db:up && npm run db:bootstrap && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w @pulse/okf-widgets
scripts.test:e2e: npm run db:up && npm run db:bootstrap && npm run test:e2e -w apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w @pulse/okf-widgets
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pulse/contracts && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w @pulse/okf-widgets
scripts.okf:view: npm run build -w @pulse/okf-widgets && node scripts/okf-view.mjs okf
scripts.okf:mermaid:render: npm run build -w @pulse/okf-widgets && node scripts/okf-view.mjs okf --check-render
scripts.okf:render:fixture: npm run build -w @pulse/okf-widgets && node scripts/okf-view.mjs scripts/fixtures/okf-render-errors --out node_modules/.cache/okf-render-fixture.html --check-render
scripts.db:bootstrap: docker compose exec -T db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v db_name="$POSTGRES_DB" -v owner_password="$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" -v app_password="$POSTGRES_PASSWORD"' < apps/api/db/bootstrap.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run db:bootstrap && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test:e2e:web: AUTH_MODE=dev npm run db:reset && playwright test --config apps/web/e2e/playwright.config.ts; status=$?; npm run db:seed; exit $status
